newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver falls near close, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver falls near close, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices opened lower and receded further towards the close on the back of increased arrivals of imported metals on Tuesday, dealers said.
Silver was down by 45 rupees per kg on Monday.
"About 3,000/4,000 kg of the imported silver has arrived today in the Bombay market and sentiment at the close remained subdued," they said.
"Industrial buyers also kept to the sidelines, expecting further price erosion while stockists were active sellers following reports of falling global prices," one broker added.
